caption: The fair worry about automation is that it'll make something up to your customer. A good agent should do the opposite: when it isn't sure, it passes the chat back to you. What's one question you'd always want to answer yourself? Comment AGENT below.

slides.headline: What if it gets a question wrong?
It's a fair worry.
slides.body: Those are your customers. A bad answer has your business name on it.

slides.headline: Some questions are simple.
slides.body: Opening hours. Areas you cover. How to book. You give the answers.

slides.headline: Others need you.
slides.body: A complaint. An unusual job. Anything your answers don't cover.

slides.headline: So it shouldn't guess.
slides.body: It should say you'll get back to them, then pass the chat to you.

slides.headline: You make the call.
slides.body: You see what was asked and reply yourself when you're free.

beats.text: What if it gets a question wrong?
Fair worry. A bad answer has your business name on it.
Simple questions get the answers you gave it.
What if it passed anything else to you, without guessing?

beats.bubble: Good question. I'll pass this on so you get a proper answer.
